reason: Provides ADB-based Android device and bench debugging operations, with logcat inspection, APK installation, file transfer, performance snapshots, crash reporting, and device health diagnostics.

summaries.zh: 通过 ADB 为 Android 设备和台架提供日志查看、APK 安装、文件传输、性能采集及崩溃与健康诊断能力。
summaries.en: Provides ADB-based Android device and bench debugging with log inspection, APK installation, file transfer, performance snapshots, and crash and health reports.

capabilities: Discovers and connects to Android devices and automotive bench rigs
Reads and filters logcat data, including background streaming
Pulls, pushes, lists, and removes device files
Collects performance, crash, and device health reports
Waits for device, boot, process, or logcat conditions
